scope: Nuxt 4.x with Vue 3, Nitro and explicitly named companion modules. Experimental APIs and provider-specific cache behavior are qualified.

ssr.note: Nuxt supports universal rendering/hydration, client-only routes and prerendered routes. Hybrid route rules choose behavior per path; this is not an assertion of Next-style partial prerendering.

streaming.note: ssrStreaming is an experimental option in Nuxt 4.x. Default universal rendering must not be represented as production HTML streaming.
streaming.label: Experimental SSR streaming

suspense.note: Nuxt uses Vue Suspense to coordinate async page data. Vue still marks Suspense experimental; data waiting alone is not out-of-order HTML delivery.
suspense.label: Vue Suspense

client.note: Nuxt supports universal rendering/hydration, client-only routes and prerendered routes. Hybrid route rules choose behavior per path; this is not an assertion of Next-style partial prerendering.

ssg.note: Nuxt supports universal rendering/hydration, client-only routes and prerendered routes. Hybrid route rules choose behavior per path; this is not an assertion of Next-style partial prerendering.

csr.note: Nuxt supports universal rendering/hydration, client-only routes and prerendered routes. Hybrid route rules choose behavior per path; this is not an assertion of Next-style partial prerendering.

serverOnly.note: The opt-in componentIslands experiment enables server components and selective hydration. It is not an unqualified stable core capability in this Nuxt 4.x review.
serverOnly.label: Experimental component islands

partialRendering.note: Hybrid rules mix prerendered, server-rendered and client-rendered routes. That does not establish a cached static shell plus dynamic holes within the same route.
partialRendering.label: Hybrid routes

routing.note: File-system pages, nested route composition, middleware and NuxtLink navigation/prefetching form the routing workflow.

layouts.note: File-system pages, nested route composition, middleware and NuxtLink navigation/prefetching form the routing workflow.

dynamicRoutes.note: File-system pages, nested route composition, middleware and NuxtLink navigation/prefetching form the routing workflow.

parallelRoutes.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt routing guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

interceptedRoutes.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt routing guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

prefetch.note: File-system pages, nested route composition, middleware and NuxtLink navigation/prefetching form the routing workflow.

softNavigation.note: NuxtLink and the integrated router update pages/history without a full reload. Internal links are prefetched according to the configured policy; external links and explicit reloads retain document navigation.
softNavigation.label: NuxtLink / Vue Router

viewTransitions.note: pageTransition/layoutTransition coordinate Vue enter/leave animations across navigation. Native browser View Transitions are a separate experimental option, not required for the stable page-transition API. Authors supply CSS and reduced-motion treatment.
viewTransitions.label: Page / layout transitions

redirects.note: File-system pages, nested route composition, middleware and NuxtLink navigation/prefetching form the routing workflow.

serverData.note: useAsyncData/useFetch share keyed state, transfer SSR payloads, deduplicate pending reads and support refresh/clear operations. This is distinct from a durable server cache.

clientData.note: useAsyncData/useFetch share keyed state, transfer SSR payloads, deduplicate pending reads and support refresh/clear operations. This is distinct from a durable server cache.

requestDedupe.note: useAsyncData/useFetch share keyed state, transfer SSR payloads, deduplicate pending reads and support refresh/clear operations. This is distinct from a durable server cache.

persistentCache.note: Route rules support SWR and ISR caching. ISR behavior and durable storage depend on the Nitro hosting preset/provider.

invalidation.note: useAsyncData/useFetch share keyed state, transfer SSR payloads, deduplicate pending reads and support refresh/clear operations. This is distinct from a durable server cache.

isr.note: Route rules support SWR and ISR caching. ISR behavior and durable storage depend on the Nitro hosting preset/provider.

apiRoutes.note: Nitro registers server endpoints/middleware and exposes H3 request, cookie and response utilities.

httpErrors.note: Nuxt distinguishes server/application error responses from client-only error boundaries. Server error helpers and response-status APIs let the application send 404 or 5xx with its error page; rendering fallback UI alone is not sufficient. Client navigation errors do not change the original document status, and streamed headers cannot be changed after publication.
httpErrors.label: Server errors / response status

actions.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt server guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

forms.note: Endpoints can read/validate request bodies, but a unified typed form-action and field-error workflow is not established by this guide.
forms.label: Endpoint validation

assessment.summary: Form transport, validation, pending feedback and optimistic state are separate behaviors; the progressive-forms and optimistic-updates rows review the latter contracts explicitly.
strengths: Endpoints can read/validate request bodies, but a unified typed form-action and field-error workflow is not established by this guide.
tradeoffs: Do not infer a no-JavaScript submission path, automatic validation, accessible field errors or rollback merely from the ability to receive FormData.

middleware.note: Nitro registers server endpoints/middleware and exposes H3 request, cookie and response utilities.

cookies.note: Nitro registers server endpoints/middleware and exposes H3 request, cookie and response utilities.

cssModules.note: Vue single-file component scoped styles and CSS Modules are supported by the build pipeline.

scopedCss.note: Vue single-file component scoped styles and CSS Modules are supported by the build pipeline.

tailwind.note: The styling guide integrates Tailwind as an external CSS compiler.
tailwind.label: Tailwind

cssInJs.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt styling guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

images.note: NuxtImg/NuxtPicture generate provider-backed responsive sizes and formats; install the companion module.
images.label: Nuxt Image

fonts.note: The companion module self-hosts fonts and generates fallback metrics; provider/configuration determines the output.
fonts.label: Nuxt Fonts

scripts.note: The companion module provides deferred third-party script loading and trigger strategies.
scripts.label: Nuxt Scripts

assetPipeline.note: Referenced assets in app/assets are processed by Vite or webpack, producing hashed production URLs with updated references. Files in public/ retain their names. Runtime-constructed paths are not automatically discovered; import assets or use an import glob when needed.
assetPipeline.label: Vite / webpack assets

staticAssets.note: Nuxt serves public directory files at unchanged paths and processes imported app/assets through the configured bundler. Public copying and content-hashed build assets are distinct behaviors.
staticAssets.label: Public directory / build assets

metadata.note: useHead/useSeoMeta provide typed reactive tags and titleTemplate composition; app.head is static configuration.

assessment.summary: A reactive, typed head API powered by Unhead, with semantic tag deduplication and title templates.
strengths: Page registrations can replace matching defaults without copying every tag.
useSeoMeta types common SEO fields while useHead supports general head elements.
tradeoffs: app.head is static; reactive values belong in composables.
Unhead tag identity/key rules differ from a nested metadata-object merge contract.

dynamicMetadata.note: useHead/useSeoMeta provide typed reactive tags and titleTemplate composition; app.head is static configuration.

metadataInheritance.note: Unhead resolves duplicate semantic identities and keys across registrations; later/page entries replace matching defaults. Explicit keys and removal behavior differ from nested metadata-object merging.

metadataOverrides.note: Unhead resolves duplicate semantic identities and keys across registrations; later/page entries replace matching defaults. Explicit keys and removal behavior differ from nested metadata-object merging.

titleTemplates.note: useHead/useSeoMeta provide typed reactive tags and titleTemplate composition; app.head is static configuration.

socialImages.note: Nuxt SEO's separately maintained OG Image, Sitemap and Robots modules add generation APIs. These are not bundled Nuxt core features.
socialImages.label: Nuxt SEO modules

sitemaps.note: Nuxt SEO's separately maintained OG Image, Sitemap and Robots modules add generation APIs. These are not bundled Nuxt core features.
sitemaps.label: Nuxt SEO modules

robots.note: Nuxt SEO's separately maintained OG Image, Sitemap and Robots modules add generation APIs. These are not bundled Nuxt core features.
robots.label: Nuxt SEO modules

markdown.note: The companion module loads Markdown and other content files with typed queries.
markdown.label: Nuxt Content

collections.note: Content collections provide schemas, querying and structured content integration.
collections.label: Nuxt Content

draftMode.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt content guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

translations.note: The companion module integrates Vue I18n catalogs, lazy messages and locale routing.
translations.label: Nuxt i18n

localeRouting.note: Locale-aware route generation, URL prefixes and SEO helpers are supplied by the i18n module.
localeRouting.label: Nuxt i18n

localeFormatting.note: The module's Vue I18n integration supplies locale-sensitive number and date formatting.
localeFormatting.label: Nuxt i18n

auth.note: The documented Nuxt Auth Utils companion supplies encrypted sessions and auth helpers. Applications still choose persistence and authorization policy.
auth.label: Nuxt Auth Utils

csp.note: nuxt-security coordinates random request nonces and strict CSP for SSR; static output uses hashes instead. The module is maintained outside Nuxt core and must be installed/configured.
csp.label: nuxt-security headers

cspNonce.note: nuxt-security coordinates random request nonces and strict CSP for SSR; static output uses hashes instead. The module is maintained outside Nuxt core and must be installed/configured.
cspNonce.label: nuxt-security

csrf.note: The separately installed nuxt-security module offers optional CSRF middleware. Enable and configure that protection for the relevant routes; installing Nuxt or using CSP alone does not provide universal CSRF protection.
csrf.label: Optional nuxt-security CSRF

environment.note: Private runtimeConfig fields stay on the server; only explicit public configuration enters page payloads. Runtime secrets can be set without rebuilding.

types.note: Nuxt generates TypeScript types and provides a project CLI and Vite hot updates.

hmr.note: Nuxt generates TypeScript types and provides a project CLI and Vite hot updates.

cli.note: Nuxt generates TypeScript types and provides a project CLI and Vite hot updates.

bundleAnalysis.note: nuxt analyze builds and serves production dependency analysis; the command is explicitly experimental.
bundleAnalysis.label: Experimental analyzer

unitTests.note: @nuxt/test-utils supplies Nuxt-aware Vitest/browser helpers, with Playwright integration.
unitTests.label: Nuxt Test Utils

e2eTests.note: @nuxt/test-utils supplies Nuxt-aware Vitest/browser helpers, with Playwright integration.
e2eTests.label: Nuxt Test Utils

observability.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt testing guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

errorHandling.note: NuxtErrorBoundary renders a resettable client fallback; server/application error pages and clearError handle broader failures.

serverHosting.note: Nitro presets target Node, serverless and worker deployments; prerendered output can be static. Target capabilities and caches vary.

subpathProxy.note: app.baseURL configures the application’s public base path, including framework routing and generated asset paths; NUXT_APP_BASE_URL can override it at runtime. Nitro’s deployment and proxy must agree on that public path and origin. Hard-coded root-relative URLs and third-party integrations still need matching configuration.
subpathProxy.label: app.baseURL / Nitro

staticHosting.note: Nitro presets target Node, serverless and worker deployments; prerendered output can be static. Target capabilities and caches vary.

containers.note: Not established in the reviewed Nuxt deployment guide. External integrations or application code may provide this behavior.

edgeHosting.note: Nitro presets target Node, serverless and worker deployments; prerendered output can be static. Target capabilities and caches vary.

orm.note: The reviewed Nuxt server/data guides do not establish an owned orm / query builder API. An application can integrate a separate provider or library; this finding does not mean that integration is impossible.

migrations.note: The reviewed Nuxt server/data guides do not establish an owned schema migrations API. An application can integrate a separate provider or library; this finding does not mean that integration is impossible.

transactions.note: The reviewed Nuxt server/data guides do not establish an owned transactions API. An application can integrate a separate provider or library; this finding does not mean that integration is impossible.

jobs.note: Nitro tasks are opt-in/experimental scheduled or programmatic work. The documented runner is not a durable queue with retries.
jobs.label: Experimental Nitro tasks

mail.note: The reviewed Nuxt server/data guides do not establish an owned email API. An application can integrate a separate provider or library; this finding does not mean that integration is impossible.

uploads.note: The reviewed Nuxt server/data guides do not establish an owned file uploads & storage API. An application can integrate a separate provider or library; this finding does not mean that integration is impossible.

realtime.note: The reviewed Nuxt server/data guides do not establish an owned real-time delivery API. An application can integrate a separate provider or library; this finding does not mean that integration is impossible.

xssEscaping.note: Its integrated UI renderer supplies this policy. Vue escapes ordinary text and attribute bindings using browser APIs/server encoding. v-html and untrusted URLs/styles need separate controls; templates themselves must be trusted.

htmlSanitization.note: The linked security API review does not establish the specific html sanitization contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

authorization.note: The linked security API review does not establish the specific authorization policies contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

rateLimiting.note: nuxt-security supplies rate-limiter middleware and a configurable unstorage driver. The default LRU store is process-local; use an appropriate shared driver for distributed limits.
rateLimiting.label: nuxt-security

progressiveEnhancement.note: The linked server API review does not establish the specific progressive forms contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

optimisticUi.note: The linked data API review does not establish the specific optimistic updates contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

requestCancellation.note: useAsyncData/useFetch expose dedupe/cancel behavior and an AbortSignal for a cancelable handler. The handler must propagate cancellation to its underlying work; this cannot undo completed server mutations.
requestCancellation.label: useAsyncData

typedLinks.note: Typed page route generation is an experimental/configuration-dependent option in the reviewed Nuxt 4 routing guide. It is not equivalent to validation of all arbitrary query values.
typedLinks.label: Experimental typedPages

searchParams.note: The linked routing API review does not establish the specific validated url state contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

stateRestoration.note: Vue KeepAlive can retain selected component instances/state across route switches when composed with RouterView; Nuxt also exposes page keepalive configuration. It is opt-in and limited by include/exclude/cache eviction.
stateRestoration.label: KeepAlive

scrollRestoration.note: Vue Router scrollBehavior receives saved positions for history traversal and lets the app return scrolling behavior. Nuxt configures it through its router integration; the app can customize it.
scrollRestoration.label: Vue Router

navigationBlocking.note: Navigation guards can return false or prompt before leaving a route, including in-component beforeRouteLeave. Full-document unload is a separate browser mechanism.
navigationBlocking.label: Vue Router guards

navigationAccessibility.note: NuxtRouteAnnouncer provides route announcements when included in the application. It is an explicit component rather than proof that every Nuxt app manages focus correctly.
navigationAccessibility.label: NuxtRouteAnnouncer

a11yChecks.note: The optional @nuxt/a11y module runs accessibility audits in development. The reviewed release is alpha; it is not stable built-in enforcement or a certification that the application is accessible.
a11yChecks.label: Alpha @nuxt/a11y module

lazyActivation.note: Nuxt documents lazy hydration triggers for delayed interactive components, built on Vue's hydration strategies. The selected trigger controls activation; this does not imply every component's code is withheld until then.
lazyActivation.label: Lazy hydration

codeSplitting.note: Nuxt splits pages automatically and supports lazy component imports. Shared dependencies and auto-import usage still influence the chunks sent to a page.
codeSplitting.label: Page / component bundles

offline.note: The linked deployment API review does not establish the specific offline integration contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

scheduling.note: The linked backend API review does not establish the specific scheduled tasks contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

notifications.note: The linked backend API review does not establish the specific multi-channel notifications contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

searchIndex.note: The linked backend API review does not establish the specific search indexing contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

fieldEncryption.note: The linked database API review does not establish the specific encrypted model fields contract defined here. This is a bounded documentation finding, not proof of absence; generic hooks or application-authored code are not counted as an owned implementation.

httpTests.note: @nuxt/test-utils provides runtime and end-to-end helpers including server fetch against a test Nuxt app. Tests that start a server have a different boundary/cost from in-process Laravel request simulation.
httpTests.label: @nuxt/test-utils
